title: claims-ledger.json
description: Validates the repository-root claims-ledger.json. Enforced by scripts/validate-manifests.py in `make check`. One row per load-bearing factual claim about a system we do not control. The schema's job is to make an unevidenced claim unrepresentable: `evidence` has a minimum length because a claim whose evidence is 'yes' is a memory, not a citation.

statuses.description: Every status the ledger uses, defined in the ledger itself, so a reader never has to guess what a status means.

claim.description: The assertion as the pack makes it, in full sentences. If it cannot be stated without the surrounding document, it is not a claim.

evidence.description: What the source actually says, quoted or closely paraphrased. This is the field that survives when the URL moves.

evidence_locator.description: An immutable pointer where one exists: file@sha, version number, table name. Required in practice for repo-file-read; a URL alone is mutable.

used_in.description: Document ids that rely on this claim. minItems 1 is the orphan check: a claim no document uses is either dead research or a document that lost its citation. The validator resolves each id against release-readiness.yml.

then.description: A repository claim must pin the file and commit it was read from.
